## Walkthrough `OperandImagesMatch` now permits deployments without `metal3-static-ip-manager`, while still validating its image when present and requiring `metal3-ironic`. Tests model optional container construction and cover matching and missing-container scenarios. ### Changes **Operand Image Matching** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Make Static IP Manager optional**
`provisioning/baremetal_pod.go`|Static IP Manager image validation is conditional on container presence; only the Ironic container is required.| |**Update image matching coverage**
`provisioning/baremetal_pod_test.go`|Test deployments can omit Static IP Manager, with cases covering optional presence, image mismatches, and missing Ironic containers.| **Estimated code review effort:** 2 (Simple) | ~10 minutes **Possibly related PRs** - [openshift/cluster-baremetal-operator#629](https://github.com/openshift/cluster-baremetal-operator/pull/629): Updates the related `OperandImagesMatch` logic and tests for Static IP Manager container handling. **Suggested labels:** `jira/valid-bug`, `jira/valid-reference` **Suggested reviewers:** `honza`
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 15
✅ Passed checks (15 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :----------------------------------------------: | :------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. | | Docstring Coverage | ✅ Passed | No functions found in the changed files to evaluate docstring coverage. Skipping docstring coverage check. | | Linked Issues check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Out of Scope Changes check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | The modified test names are fixed string literals in table-driven t.Run cases; no timestamps, IDs, IPs, or generated values appear in titles. | | Test Structure And Quality | ✅ Passed | Table-driven unit test uses fake clients only; no cluster setup/waits/timeouts, and each subtest targets one OperandImagesMatch case. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PASS: The PR only updates unit tests and deployment image logic; it adds no Ginkgo e2e tests, MicroShift-specific APIs, or unsupported namespaces/features. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Only plain Go unit tests changed; no Ginkgo e2e specs or SNO-sensitive assumptions were added. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Only operand image matching and tests changed; no new node selectors, affinities, spread constraints, replicas, or anti-affinity were introduced. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | The PR only changes helper/test logic; no main/init/TestMain/suite setup or stdout writes (fmt.Print/klog/log.SetOutput) appear in the touched files. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Only standard Go unit tests changed; no Ginkgo e2e tests, public internet calls, or IPv6-hostile networking assumptions were added. | | No-Weak-Crypto | ✅ Passed | Diff only relaxes image matching for optional metal3-static-ip-manager and updates tests; no crypto imports, hashes, ciphers, or constant-time comparisons added. | | Container-Privileges | ✅ Passed | Diff only makes static-ip-manager optional in image matching/tests; no privilege/securityContext fields were added or changed. | | No-Sensitive-Data-In-Logs | ✅ Passed | No logging additions or changes in the touched files; the diff only updates container-image matching and tests, with no sensitive data emitted. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title clearly matches the main change: making static-ip-manager optional. |
✨ Finishing Touches
🧪 Generate unit tests (beta) - [ ] Create PR with unit tests
